system.description:
Protects against psychic intrusion and attacks with the Psychic Weapon Enhancement. Provides a roll bonus and mental armor.
Level 1: +2 bonus and 5 mental armor
Level 2: +4 bonus and 10 mental armor
Level 3: +6 bonus and 15 mental armor
Level 4: +8 bonus and 20 mental armor
Level 5: +10 bonus and 25 mental armor
Level 6: +12 bonus and 30 mental armor
